digest_markdown:
• Up to 18,000 customers installed a malicious Orion software update, allowing hackers to access and imitate victims' accounts/users, access system files, and work among SolarWinds' legitimate activities. [1]
• In 2025, more than 454,600 new malicious open-source packages were logged, with over 99% of 2025's open source malware on npm. [2]
• Third-party involvement is now featured in about half of breaches, with 48% of breaches in 2026 involving third-party organizations, a 60% increase on the previous year's dataset. [3]
• Suppliers often cannot say how they were breached, with 66% of supply chain attacks in 2021 found that suppliers did not know, or failed to report, how they were compromised. [3]
• Supply chain compromise raises breach cost, with supply chain compromise being the largest cost-increasing factor in Canada, adding about CA$367,899 per breach. [3]
